source.question: Why did well F-99 stop producing in 2013?

submission.summary: Well F-99 does not exist in the Volve dataset and has no production records, so it did not stop producing in 2013; the only producers active that year were F-11, F-12 and F-14.

findings.claim: Well F-99 has no production records in the Volve database (0 daily records).
findings.detail: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_daily WHERE well='F-99' returns 0; all 7 well names in the database are F-1 C, F-11, F-12, F-14, F-15 D, F-4 and F-5 (E1, E7, E9).

findings.claim: The Volve production data covers only seven well entries, none named F-99, so a stop in 2013 cannot be attributed to it.
findings.detail: list_wells (E1) and production_daily distinct wells (E2, E7) list F-1 C, F-11, F-12, F-14, F-15 D, F-4, F-5. Search of reports for F-99 returns no Volve well (only F-11 B completion reports, E3). Field activity in 2013 was completion of F-11 B in June-July 2013 and ongoing production from F-12 and F-14.

volve_pud.title: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation)

rows: Well F-11 B is tied into the platform with 14” Production Risers from subsea WH to surface WH
The wells are tied into the platform with 14” Production Risers from subsea WH to surface WH.
Both wells in the oil zone have been production tested and showed good production properties.
Begge brønner i oljesonen har blitt produksjonstestet og viste gode produksjonsegenskaper.
The development concept is down-flank water injection with production wells placed high on the structure.
nedflanks vanninjeksjon med produksjonsbrønner plassert høyt på strukturen.
The Volve field is planned to be developed with three oil production wells and three water injection wells, plus two water production wells to the Utsira formation for production of injection water.

Volvefeltet er planlagt utbygd med tre oljeproduksjonsbrønner og tre vanninjeksjonsbrønner. I tillegg er det planlagt å bore to vannproduksjonsbrønner til Utsira-formasjonen for produksjon av injeksjonsvann.
The three production wells are planned to be completed with gas lift equipment.
De tre produksjonsbrønnene er planlagt komplettert med gassløft utstyr.
About 50 production wells have been drilled for the gas/condensate fields in Block 15/9.
det er boret ca 50 produksjonsbrønner for dette formål.
The two non-communicating segments will be developed with dedicated production and injection wells.
De to ikkekommuniserende segmentene vil bli utviklet med dedikerte produksjons og injeksjonsbrønner.

The proposed drilling programme handles reservoir uncertainties in the reservoir model, with one producer prepared for production start while the remaining wells are drilled during the production period to collect dynamic data to optimize placement of the remaining wells.

Det foreslåtte boreprogrammet ivaretar reservoarusikkerheter i reservoarmodellen. En produsent klargjøres for produksjonsstart, mens resten av brønnene bores i løpet av produksjonsperioden. Dette muliggjør innsamling av dynamiske data som er til hjelp å optimalisere plassering av de gjenværende brønnene.
